title: NY RE Exam - Mistakes Bank
prompt: iPhone 393x852 dark OLED screen for a NYS real estate salesperson exam study app, design system "NY RE Exam v2 Wayfinding": canvas #090d16, cards #111725 radius 18, controls #182033 radius 14, primary green #10b981, red #ef4444 only for destructive, Helvetica Neue bold sentence-case headings, system UI body, no all-caps labels, no arrows on buttons, no middle-dot separators. Topics are shown as NYC subway route bullets: small colored circles with a bold 1-character code (red 1, blue A, orange B, yellow Q, green 4) always next to the topic name. Floating translucent glass capsule tab bar at the bottom inset 12px with 5 tabs (Home, Build, Stats, Mistakes, More), active tab has a small green pill. Compact 28px large-title header at top. Screen: "Mistakes" tab active. Header title "Mistakes". Top summary card: a large tabular number "6" with the label "questions to clear" and a short rule line "Answer one correctly twice in a row to clear it." Below it one dominant full-width green 56px "Review mistakes" button. Then a list of missed-question cards: each card has the route bullet + topic name on the first row, the question text clamped to 2 lines, and a bottom row with a tiny 2-station line progress (two station dots joined by a short track; first filled green when 1 of 2) labeled "0 of 2" or "1 of 2", and a quiet text "Clear" action on the right. Show 4 cards with varied topics and progress. Bottom padding so the floating tab bar does not cover content.
